title: HB 9001 (Introduced) — Relating to public library hours (FICTIONAL SAMPLE)
text:
FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE. Not a real measure.

Section 1. Each county library district shall keep at least one branch open on Saturdays.

Section 2. The State Librarian shall report annually on weekend library hours.
